name: Li Qian
current_role: Chairman, Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research Co., Ltd. (STAR Market: 688621)
profile: Li Qian (利虔) is chairman and largest shareholder (~38%) of Beijing Sun-Novo Pharmaceutical Research, a CRO providing preclinical and clinical drug R&D services, which he has chaired since 2009. He also chairs Beijing Baiao Pharmaceuticals and is founder/executive director of Jiangsu Langyan Life Technology. Sun-Novo reported 2025 revenue of about RMB 1.22bn.
interesting_fact: Sun-Novo describes itself as moving from a pure CRO 'service provider' toward an innovation-driven 'partner' with its own self-developed drugs; 2025 revenue rose 12.9% to RMB 1.218bn and net profit 10.5% to RMB 196m.
deep_cut_fact: Besides Sun-Novo, he founded Jiangsu Langyan Life Technology Holdings (exec director since Jan 2016) and has been a non-executive director of Eastenova (Chengdu) Biotechnology since 2025; he studied at Peking University Health Science Center.
notes: Personally hosts investor meetings (e.g. March 2026) alongside IR director Guo Xinchi (郭心驰) and board secretary Wei Liping (魏丽萍); IR route is via SSE E-Interaction / company IR hotline. Company site sun-novo.com was unreachable during research.

name: Sheng Junhai
profile: Listed by Hurun (2006-2017) with wealth from Romon (罗蒙), a Ningbo (Fenghua) menswear/suit maker founded in 1978. No source found during this task naming Sheng Junhai (盛军海) at Romon; Romon's official site names Sheng Jingsheng (盛静生) as group chairman.
notes: Could not confirm identity or current role. Possibly a Hurun name variant or family member of chairman Sheng Jingsheng (unverified). Romon group general contact published on romon.com: romon@romon.com, hotline 0574-88888888 (company, not personal).

name: Zhu Mingyue
current_role: Founder, Chairman and CEO, ZBJ (Zhubajie / 猪八戒网), Chongqing
profile: Zhu Mingyue (朱明跃) founded ZBJ.com in Chongqing in 2006, an online marketplace for outsourced services that began with crowdsourced logo design and became a unicorn after a RMB 2.6bn investment in 2015. A former Chongqing Evening News reporter, he is also a National People's Congress deputy and still leads the company as founder and CEO.
interesting_fact: In Feb 2020, with ZBJ's 3,000+ staff and over RMB 60m monthly fixed costs, he told employees 'Unless self-rescue, the cash flow will break in three months' and ran an all-employee online push; he later said post-resumption indicators exceeded expectations.
deep_cut_fact: Before tech he was a primary-school teacher for 3 years and a reporter for 8; while still at Chongqing Evening News he paid RMB 500 to have a website built to understand the internet, then quit at 32 to found ZBJ.
notes: Active NPC deputy who comments publicly on SME and gig-worker policy (e.g. Beijing News, Mar 2023). No published press email found; zbj.com lists only a complaints address. Best route likely via ZBJ corporate PR.

name: Wang Lingli
current_role: Co-controlling shareholder and administrative manager (as of 2020 annual report), Anhui Coreach Technology Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 002983)
profile: Wang Lingli (王玲丽) and her husband Peng You (chairman and general manager) are the actual controllers of Anhui Coreach Technology, a Hefei-based maker of display optoelectronic (backlight) systems and smart lighting, listed in Shenzhen. Per the 2020 annual report, the couple controlled about 71% of the company, hers held via two partnerships she runs.
interesting_fact: Coreach's ownership is a husband-wife structure: Peng You held 55.76% directly while Wang Lingli, as executive partner of Xinhui Investment and Xinzhi Consulting, controlled another 15.38%.
deep_cut_fact: She is executive partner of Xinzhi Consulting, Coreach's employee share-ownership partnership (she contributed 45.79% of its capital), and of Anhui Xinhui Investment, set up in March 2016.
notes: Low public profile; husband Peng You is the public face. Role info from the 2020 annual report (Mar 2021); may have changed. IR email is the company securities department.

name: Kwok Chi Leong
current_role: Executive Director and Chairman, Wing On Company International Limited (HKEX: 289)
profile: Karl Kwok Chi Leung (郭志樑), BBS, MH, is chairman of Wing On Company International, the Hong Kong-listed holding company of the Wing On department-store business founded by the Kwok family in 1907; he is a third-generation family leader and the board is still Kwok-family run. He is also a prominent offshore yachtsman and Hong Kong sports administrator.
interesting_fact: His yacht Beau Geste won the 1997 Sydney to Hobart race overall, months after Hong Kong's handover; he says he remains the only Chinese skipper to have won it, and he also won the 2009 Transatlantic Maxi Yacht Cup and the China Sea Race twice.
deep_cut_fact: He first sailed as a university student in Minnesota in the late 1960s on a Hobie 16 catamaran; every boat he has owned since has been named Beau Geste, and he now also races a Fast 40 called Beau Ideal. He was president of the Sailing Federation of Hong Kong 1990-2010.
notes: Hurun spelling 'Leong'; HKEX filings use 'Kwok Chi Leung Karl'. Event Ambassador for the 2027 Hong Kong Dragon World Championship - sailing is a strong outreach hook. Board list confirmed in HKEX announcement of 15 June 2026: https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2026/0615/2026061500421.pdf

name: Wu Shiming
current_role: Chairman, Beijing Succeeder Technology Inc. (赛科希德, STAR Market: 688338)
profile: Wu Shiming (吴仕明), born 1957, built Beijing Succeeder Technology, a Beijing maker of in-vitro diagnostic instruments and reagents for coagulation/thrombosis testing. He ran its predecessor as chairman and GM from 2003, has chaired the joint-stock company since Dec 2015, and still chairs the board (2025 annual report, Apr 2026).
interesting_fact: Before founding Succeeder he spent 1995-2003 at Beijing Shidi Scientific Instrument Co.; he was also Succeeder's general manager 2017-2020 before handing day-to-day management to Wang Hai, a former PLA General Hospital lab technician.
deep_cut_fact: Since April 2020 he has also been director and GM of Beijing Sainuo Xide Medical Technology, and since 2017 executive partner of Beijing Sainuoheng, Succeeder's employee share-ownership platform.
notes: Hurun lists source as 'Succeeder' (Beijing Succeeder Technology / 赛科希德), not to be confused with Beijing SL Pharmaceutical (赛升药业). Low media profile; IR email is the best route.
